

== Documented PC state ==
The Players Committee’s 2023 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A, page 130, documents this version’s replacement game text and grabber-icon amendment. Released uses by 2023, based on the publisher’s identified 2023 edition.<ref name="pc-documented-state">Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, page 130, Tentacle: replacement game text and grabber-icon amendment.</ref> The earlier PC wording that uses “grabbed” is a separate state and is not assigned this bound. The complete current PC illustration matches the documented replacement game text and grabber icon. The original manufacturer face corroborates the retained title, Lore, destiny, card type and uniqueness; it has no grabber icon.<ref>[[Media:ANH-D-tentacle-decipher-archive.gif|Original manufacturer face]]; [[Media:ANH-D-tentacle.gif|PC illustration]].</ref> The Title property follows the printed title without the article qualifier. The article name, existing mapping, complete game text, other date fields, statistics and assets are unchanged. — [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] 19 November 2026 (UTC)
